answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that multiplies with clones. Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after several consecutive epochs of peer-graded original work; farms burn capital while one honest identity earns. Treat that bond as an atlas of scarce commitments, not free names. Peer grades arrive along a ridge of independent juries, so sock puppets cannot self-attest into a majority. When an account sits in a gale of failing quorum, slash the bond and bar re-entry for many epochs—raising the price of fake majorities without locking out careful latecomers.
